intro.text: Built by Agents. Built for Agents. AGNT, Inc. (Nasdaq: AGNT) is the global parent company of eXp Realty®, the most agent-centric™ real estate brokerage on the planet, NextHome, Inc., an award-winning national real estate franchise, FrameVR.io, a virtual collaboration platform, and SUCCESS® Enterprises, a leading personal development and media brand for entrepreneurs. Together, the AGNT platform provides a world-class multi-model operating system empowering independent agents, franchise owners, and team leaders across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Asia Pacific, and South Africa. As a publicly traded company, AGNT prioritizes transparency, innovation, and long-term value for agents, franchise owners, staff, and shareholders.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Wages, services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Other current liabilities
lines.why: Other operating items due within a year: operating.

lines.name: Current portion of long-term debt
lines.why: Borrowed money falling due within a year: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Other assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total assets minus the lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total liabilities minus the lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

s.t: The North American Realty segment includes operations across all 50 U.S. states and all Canadian provinces and represented 96.9% of total consolidated revenues in 2025.

The International Realty segment includes operations in 27 countries throughout the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Asia-Pacific, and South Africa and represented 3.1% of total consolidated revenues in 2025.

For the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023 approximately 13 %, 11 % and 9 %, respectively, of the Company’s total revenue was generated outside of the U.S. Long-lived assets held outside of the U.S. were 10 % and 17 % as of December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.

As noted in this Annual Report, the National Association of Realtors (“NAR”), and various Multiple Listing Service (“MLS”) systems are the primary source for third-party industry data and those systems generally state that the information contained therein has been obtained from sources believed to be reliable.

The Company also utilizes part-time and temporary employees and consultants when necessary; in a limited number of the Company’s foreign markets, the Company relies on the use of indirect employment structures where personnel providing certain services to the foreign entities are employed by a contractor of the Company and are not employed by the Company.
Fluctuations in housing inventory levels can negatively impact the Company’s business, which depends on the ability of its brokers and agents to facilitate home sales.
The Company depends on the industry experience and talent of its current executives.
In addition, the Company relies on third-party vendors to provide key components of the Company’s cloud office platform and to provide additional systems and related support.
The Company’s operations rely on the performance of real estate brokers and agents.
The Company also depends on access to MLSs in the Company’s markets, which serve as critical sources of property data and listing distribution.

The Company also assesses cybersecurity risks presented by key suppliers and service providers , document their security posture through internal tools, and in certain cases requires third party audit reports or contractual notification of security incidents.
